prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE high-fidelity complete screen for HEAV3NS-CODE, a native macOS workspace for the LUMI coding agent. This is a product journey concept, not a website. Flat straight-on screenshot, entire app window fills a 1600x1000 landscape 16:10 image. No perspective, desktop wallpaper, presentation frame, annotations, labels outside the app, or collage.
Shared visual language: a carefully crafted native macOS shell with IDE density and navigation learned from VS Code and Xcode. Neutral graphite window and sidebar (#20242b), deeper code canvas (#171b21), subtly lighter title bar (#282d35), off-white readable text (#edf1f6), secondary text (#b3becd), and restrained blue (#3985f5) for selection and primary actions. Thin separators, natural 6–10px native control corners, SF-style system text and SF Mono-style code. Precise alignment and readable 14–16px body type at this image size. Do not make a generic web dashboard, large marketing headline, bento layout, neon/glass design, or chunky card collage. macOS traffic lights at top left. Product name exact: HEAV3NS-CODE (digit 3). Project name exact: LUMI-NEW.
Every screen uses the same restrained typography, palette, window chrome, and recognizable controls. Short copy is rendered verbatim. These are illustrative prototype states; do not invent factual metrics, prices, model versions, customer claims, account data, or shipped functionality. No invented company logos. Use plain product typography when no logo is provided.
For sign-in states: the app offers Sign in with ChatGPT and hands off to the system browser. Do not paint an in-app password, email, or API-key form or a counterfeit OpenAI login page. Sign-in and AI plan permission are distinct. Show plan-enabled state only in the explicitly described authorized example.
For workspace states: inspection remains read-only and says so. File tabs and syntax tint are visual navigation proposals. No stage, commit, apply, deploy, automatic file deletion, debugger, terminal, or extension-store controls. Show files as a directory hierarchy and classes as an Outline inside the active file, never disguise classes as disk folders.

SCREEN 12: Return to previous work
Session history in the SAME IDE workspace. Workspace shell: 48px native title bar with traffic lights, small project switcher "LUMI-NEW", central command field "Search files and symbols", right "Connected" and a Stop control. A narrow 76px navigation rail on the far left contains consistent outline icons WITH visible small labels: "Explorer", "Search", "Changes", "Sessions"; bottom "Projects" and "Account". Explorer is selected unless this scene says otherwise. Next a 280px Explorer pane. Center about 810px is the read-only file canvas. Right about 420px is the LUMI conversation pane. Bottom thin status bar reads "main" at left and "Swift · UTF-8 · Read only" at right. No duplicate navigation icons. A project tree with restrained indent guides and folder chevrons shows "LUMI-NEW", "native", "Sources", "Heav3nsCode", then Swift files "App.swift", "WorkspaceWindow.swift", "NavigationSidebar.swift", "RuntimeClient.swift", "ApprovalReview.swift". Beneath the expanded Sources branch are "Tests" and "Package.swift"; at root "src", "docs", "README.md". Use understated orange Swift file icons, blue folders, and clear selected-row fill; filenames never collide with icons or truncate unnecessarily. An "OUTLINE" section belongs below the file tree, with small type glyphs for class, property, and method. The right LUMI pane always has a visible composer at its bottom, Send or Queue, plus "Using ChatGPT plan" and "Manage usage" as small account affordances. Use standard toolbar, disclosure and source-list affordances, rather than blocks of decorative cards. Sessions rail selected. Replace Explorer contents with heading "Sessions", search field "Find a session", group "TODAY" and selected list row "Refine sidebar spacing" with subtext "Completed · 10:42". Second row "Explain workspace structure", subtext "Completed · 10:18". Group "YESTERDAY", row "Review navigation", subtext "Cancelled · 16:05". Main canvas is a readable run-detail view, heading "Refine sidebar spacing", metadata "Completed · Today", then sections "Instruction" with "Tighten the sidebar spacing without changing behavior.", "Result" with "Workspace and navigation spacing were updated.", and "Evidence" with "Checks not run · Not reviewed". Native button "View recorded output". A quiet note "Reading this session does not restart work." Right LUMI pane heading "Continue the conversation", explanation "Send a follow-up when you’re ready.", composer showing "Review the previous changes." and Send. Top-left project switcher and bottom Projects rail destination remain visible, enabling return to project library. Preserve native dark materials and sane IDE density; no activity graphs, productivity statistics, stage/commit/apply buttons, or automatic Resume action.

Input image roles: preserve the supplied HEAV3NS-CODE reference's native identity, shared dark material and typography. Where a prior screen is supplied, preserve the app's design system while replacing only the screen content with this scene. Any VS Code image is a navigation reference, never content, branding or annotations to copy.
